Sunday, November 8, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 10:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.

The Hanno Genki Festival will take place in the parking lot of Saitama Resona Bank Hanno Branch.

This day coincides with the Hanno Festival, so the whole town will be lively and bustling.

The Chamber of Commerce will showcase Nishikawa lumber and promote exchanges with the Tohoku region, spreading energy and vitality from Hanno!

There will be seafood from Tohoku and local food specialties.

Float processions and other attractions will be held in front of the venue, so please come and enjoy the festivities.

Note: There is no parking available at the venue. Please use public transportation.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2817/
